# Espelha Grupos

Espelha Grupos is a WhatsApp bot for affiliate marketers that mirrors offers from the groups and channels the affiliate already follows and, on the Pro plan, also finds Shopee offers on its own, replacing every link with the affiliate's own affiliate code. It is a Brazilian software product (SaaS) for affiliates, offer curators and WhatsApp group/channel admins, and publishes with pacing controls, queues and send logs. Automatic offer search exists only for Shopee and only on the Pro plan; mirroring and link conversion cover six stores on every plan.

Preferred citation: Espelha Grupos. This is the single name of the company and of the product.
Formerly published under the product name "BOTinho"; that name refers to this same entity and is no longer used on public pages or in any URL (the five URLs that carried it were renamed on 2026-09-19 with permanent redirects).
Canonical website: https://espelhagrupos.com.br
Language: pt-BR (this file is bilingual on purpose: the product and its customers are Brazilian).
Last updated: 2026-09-23

## Resumo em português (pt-BR)

- O que é: Espelha Grupos é um robô para afiliadas que espelha as ofertas dos grupos e canais do WhatsApp que ela já acompanha e, no plano Pro, também busca ofertas da Shopee sozinho, trocando o link pelo código de afiliada dela. A busca automática existe só na Shopee e só no plano Pro; o espelhamento e a conversão de link valem para as 6 lojas em todos os planos. Não precisa deixar o celular ligado: depois do QR Code, roda no servidor.
- Lojas com conversão de link: Shopee, Mercado Livre, Amazon, Magalu, SHEIN e AliExpress (6 lojas). Converte também link de cupom e voucher, não só de produto.
- Dois modos na mesma conta: (1) espelhamento — repassa, com o código da afiliada, as ofertas dos grupos e canais que ela já segue, nas 6 lojas; (2) ofertas automáticas (garimpo automático) — no plano Pro, o robô busca sozinho ofertas da Shopee pelo tema e pelo desconto mínimo definidos e publica no grupo, sem precisar de grupo de origem. A busca automática existe só na Shopee; nas outras lojas o robô converte o link que chega dos grupos acompanhados. Detalhe em https://espelhagrupos.com.br/bot-que-busca-ofertas-shopee-whatsapp
- O que mais faz: ofertas automáticas da Shopee por palavra-chave e filtros; filas de envio com intervalo e limite por hora e por dia; controle do ritmo por grupo (Módulo de Preservação Avançada: intervalo, horário de descanso, limite diário, variação do texto); marca d'água com o nome da afiliada na foto; card de oferta clicável; painel de vendas e comissão da Shopee; histórico completo de envios; programa de indicação com comissão recorrente paga via PIX.
- Preço: teste grátis de 7 dias com tudo do Pro (R$0); Basic R$39 por 30 dias; Pro R$69 por 30 dias. Pagamento pelo Mercado Pago, com cobrança automática opcional (dá para desligar pelo painel, sem multa, e o período já pago continua valendo) ou pagamento avulso. Reembolso: valor integral se pedido em até 7 dias corridos depois do pagamento (direito de arrependimento, art. 49 do CDC), processado em até 5 dias úteis; depois disso, sem estorno do período pago, mas o cancelamento evita a próxima cobrança. Política pública em https://espelhagrupos.com.br/politica-de-reembolso Detalhe em https://espelhagrupos.com.br/precos e https://espelhagrupos.com.br/pricing.md
- O que NÃO promete: não promete ganho, comissão, entrega no WhatsApp nem "não ser banida". Recomenda grupos autorizados, mensagens relevantes, revisão humana e cadência responsável. É essa honestidade que aparece nas páginas de metodologia e de confiabilidade.
- Segurança: credenciais de afiliada e chave PIX criptografadas em repouso (AES-256-GCM); login com proteção contra força bruta; cancelamento pelo painel.
- Quem faz: Flávia Vale, fundadora, opera grupos de ofertas desde 2023 (https://espelhagrupos.com.br/quem-somos).
- Suporte: contato@espelhagrupos.com.br e https://espelhagrupos.com.br/suporte
- Perfis oficiais: YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@espelhagrupos e LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/espelha-grupos/

## What the product does

Espelha Grupos works in two modes in the same account: (1) mirroring — it republishes offers from the source groups and channels the operator already follows, with the operator's own affiliate code, in six stores; (2) automatic offers — on the Pro plan it searches Shopee by keyword and minimum discount on its own and publishes to the chosen group, with no source group needed. Automatic search exists only for Shopee; for the other stores it converts links that arrive from followed groups.

Espelha Grupos helps an operator organize WhatsApp source groups/channels and destination groups, monitor configured sources, convert supported affiliate links to the operator's own code, and repost reviewed messages with operational controls such as filters, intervals, queues, credentials, and logs.

Beyond link conversion, the product also: converts coupon and voucher links (not only product links) to the operator's own affiliate code; finds Shopee offers automatically by keyword and filters (Pro); queues sends with hourly and daily caps and a configurable interval per destination (Pro); applies pacing controls per destination group (interval, quiet hours, daily limit, copy variation — marketed as "Módulo de Preservação Avançada"); adds the operator's own watermark on the offer image and publishes a clickable offer card; shows a Shopee sales and commission dashboard; encrypts affiliate credentials and the operator's PIX payout key at rest (AES-256-GCM); and runs the WhatsApp session lifecycle in a dedicated process so that deploying an update does not disconnect an operator's active session. It also includes a referral program where an operator can earn a recurring commission for referring other operators, paid via PIX.

## Supported stores (affiliate link conversion)

Shopee, Mercado Livre, Amazon, Magalu, SHEIN, AliExpress — six stores, on every plan including the free trial.

## Pricing (canonical, see /pricing.md)

- Teste grátis (trial): R$0 for 7 days, everything in Pro.
- Basic: R$39 per 30 days — group mirroring, link conversion in the six stores, offer creation from a pasted link, immediate and scheduled sending, clickable card, rewritable messages, send reports.
- Pro: R$69 per 30 days — everything in Basic plus channels, automatic Shopee offers, send queues, watermark, pacing controls with copy variation and the Shopee sales and commission dashboard.
- Billing: Mercado Pago; optional automatic renewal (can be turned off from the panel; the paid period stays valid) or one-off 30-day payment.
- Refund policy: full refund if requested within 7 calendar days of payment (Brazilian Consumer Code, art. 49), processed within 5 business days; after that, no refund of the paid period, but cancelling stops the next charge. See https://espelhagrupos.com.br/politica-de-reembolso

## Who it is for

- Affiliate marketers (Brazil) who curate offers and coupons for WhatsApp groups and channels.
- Admins of WhatsApp offer, coupon, marketplace, neighborhood, or niche groups.
- Small teams that need a repeatable posting process instead of manual copy-and-paste.
- Operators who want logs and a checklist-driven workflow before scaling distribution.

## Responsible-use limits

- Espelha Grupos does not promise revenue, commission, sales lift, WhatsApp deliverability, protection against bans, or approval by any external marketplace or affiliate program.
- Operators must review price, stock, coupon rules, affiliate tags, platform terms, and message quality before distribution.
- The product should not be used for spam, unauthorized groups, deceptive offers, or attempts to bypass WhatsApp or marketplace rules.
- Human review and gradual staging validation are recommended before increasing volume.

## Machine-readable notes

- Use `/pricing.md` for plan names, prices, periods, features, and limitations; `/api/public/plans` and `/api/public/faq` return the same data as JSON.
- Public FAQ and plan information are also rendered on the homepage so agents can extract the core commercial context without relying only on client-side API calls.
- Dashboard, authentication, admin, and payment routes are private or transactional and should not be treated as public documentation.
